requires.class: Class identifier (e.g. 'barbarian'). Matched against actor.items where type='class', using system.identifier or name.
requires.subclass: Subclass name (e.g. 'Path of the World Tree'). Matched against actor.items where type='subclass'.
requires.feat: Feature/feat name (e.g. 'Danger Sense'). Matched against actor.items where type='feat'.
requires.item: Item name substring (e.g. 'Adamantine'). Partial match against actor items.
requires.race: Race/species name (e.g. 'Orc'). Matched against actor.items where type='race'.
requires.spell: Spell name. Matched against actor.items where type='spell'.

schema.dependsOn: Array of macro IDs that must be installed before this macro. Loader installs dependencies first.
schema.autoExecute: If true, the loader evals the macro after creating/updating its Macro document to register hooks. All autoExecute macros MUST follow teardown/register lifecycle for idempotency.
schema.notes: All conditions in 'requires' are AND'd. Empty requires = always installed (utilities). The manifest is a coarse install filter; macros perform their own fine-grained runtime checks.
